checks.title: Ensure password history is reported by local policy
checks.rationale: Password history helps prevent users from cycling back to recently used passwords.
checks.remediation: Configure password history in Local Security Policy or through Group Policy.
checks.audit: Run net accounts and review the password history setting.

checks.title: Ensure account lockout threshold is present
checks.rationale: Account lockout policy reduces password guessing exposure.
checks.remediation: Configure Account Lockout Policy in Local Security Policy or Group Policy.

checks.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender service is running
checks.rationale: Endpoint anti-malware protection should be active.
checks.remediation: Start Microsoft Defender Antivirus Service and investigate any policy disabling it.

checks.title: Ensure Defender real-time protection value can be queried
checks.rationale: Real-time protection provides continuous malware monitoring.

checks.title: Ensure User Account Control is enabled
checks.remediation: Set EnableLUA to 1 and reboot if required.

checks.title: Review local administrator group membership
checks.audit: Review members of the local Administrators group and confirm every account is approved.
checks.rationale: Excess local administrator membership increases privilege escalation risk.
checks.remediation: Remove unauthorized members from the local Administrators group.
